labels.exposure_basis: percent BOUND for polymyxin B1 only
labels.record_level: commercial pooled serum (Equitech-Bio); triplicate per concentration; mean ± SD
labels.reason: The table reports concentration-specific percent bound for polymyxin B1 in pooled mouse serum using equilibrium dialysis and ultrafiltration. The note identifies a conflicting mouse source. This page does not resolve that conflict or establish the binding value to use for translation.

evidence.quote: Mouse serum protein binding of polymyxin B1
Pure in-vitro spiking of commercial pooled serum (Equitech-Bio); equilibrium dialysis (ED) and ultrafiltration (UF), triplicate per concentration, 37 °C 2 h.
Values are percent BOUND for polymyxin B1 only, mean ± SD. Spiked concentrations 1.25–10 µg/mL. Not ELF or tissue binding.
Conflicts with S21 (rat 80% bound, UF) and S02 (mouse about 91%). Do not average sources; treat fu as a sensitivity parameter.

findings.reason: The mouse ED and UF values in this table differ from the note's reference to S02 at about 91%. The note also references a rat value from S21, but this page supplies no rat table measurements. These sources cannot be reconciled from this item.
findings.needed_material: Review the underlying S02 and S21 records with their species, matrices, methods and conditions; retain the mouse and rat conflicts separately and define the source-specific fu sensitivity inputs.

findings.reason: The page states serum, binding methods, temperature, duration and spiked concentration range. It does not state pH, nonspecific binding, recovery or mass balance, or establish applicability beyond this serum experiment.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported pH and assay recovery or mass-balance details if available, plus a scoped applicability assessment for the intended concentration basis and matrix.
